  dashboard:

```{r, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)
library(fivethirtyeight) 

candy <- fivethirtyeight::candy_rankings 

candy <- candy |> 
  mutate(type = case_when(
    chocolate & fruity ~ "both",
    chocolate ~ "chocolate",
    fruity ~ "fruity",
    .default = "other"))

# count(candy, type)

type_colors <- c(
  chocolate = "#7B4B2A",
  fruity    = "#E4572E",
  other     = "#8E9AAF",
  both      = "#F3A712")
```

# Dashboard

## Row 1 {height="15%"}

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Total Candies"

list(
  icon = "basket", 
  color = "warning", 
  value = nrow(candy))

```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Number of Fruity Candies"


list(
  icon = "heart-fill",
  color = "#E4572E",
  value = sum(candy$type == "fruity"))

```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Number of Chocolate Candies"

list(
  icon = "heart",
  color = "#7B4B2A",
  value = sum(candy$type == "chocolate"))
```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Average win %"

list(
  icon  = "trophy",
  color = "#8E9AAF",
  value = paste0(round(mean(candy$winpercent)), "%"))
```

## Row 2

### Column 1

```{r}
#| title: Win % by candy type

boxplot <- ggplot(candy, aes(type, winpercent, color = type, fill = type)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.15, width = 0.55, outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(aes(text = paste0(competitorname, "<br>", round(winpercent, 2), "%")),
            width = 0.1, height = 0, size = 2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = type_colors) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = type_colors) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Win %") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    legend.position    = "none",
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor   = element_blank())

ggplotly(boxplot, tooltip = "text") |>
  style(boxpoints = FALSE, hoverinfo = "none", traces = 1:4) |>
  layout(font = list(family = "Neucha")) |>
  config(displayModeBar = FALSE)
```

### Column 2 {.tabset width="55%"}

```{r}
#| title: Top 15

top15 <- candy |>
  slice_max(winpercent, n = 15) |>
  mutate(competitorname = fct_reorder(competitorname, winpercent)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = winpercent, y = competitorname, color = type, text = paste0(competitorname, "<br>", round(winpercent, 2), "%"))) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = 0, xend = winpercent, yend = competitorname), linewidth = 1, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_point(size = 3.5) +
  scale_color_manual(values = type_colors) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 90), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(x = "Win %", y = NULL, color = "Type") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor   = element_blank() )

ggplotly(top15, tooltip = "text") |>
  layout(font = list(family = "Neucha"), legend = list(orientation = "h", y = 1.08)) |>
  config(displayModeBar = FALSE)
```

```{r}
#| title: Bottom 15

bottom15 <- candy |>
  slice_min(winpercent, n = 15) |>
  mutate(competitorname = fct_reorder(competitorname, winpercent)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = winpercent, y = competitorname, color = type, text = paste0(competitorname, "<br>", round(winpercent, 2), "%"))) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = 0, xend = winpercent, yend = competitorname), linewidth = 1, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_point(size = 3.5) +
  scale_color_manual(values = type_colors) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 90), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(x = "Win %", y = NULL, color = "Type") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor   = element_blank() )

ggplotly(bottom15, tooltip = c("y", "x")) |>
  layout(font = list(family = "Neucha"),
         legend = list(orientation = "h", y = 1.08)) |>
  config(displayModeBar = FALSE)
```

```{r}
#| title: All candies

candy |>
  arrange(desc(winpercent)) |>
  transmute(
    Candy          = competitorname,
    Type           = type,
    `Win %`        = round(winpercent, 1),
    `Sugar pctile` = round(sugarpercent * 100),
    `Price pctile` = round(pricepercent * 100)) |>
  knitr::kable()
```

# About

::: {.card title="About this dashboard"}
**Where the data comes from:** FiveThirtyEight's Halloween candy survey. People were shown two candies at a time and picked the one they'd rather get.

**Win %** is how often a candy won those head-to-head matchups. 50% means it won about half the time.

**Reading the box plot:** each dot is one candy, and the box shows the middle 50% of candies of that type. "Both" has only one candy (chocolate *and* fruity), so it's just a single dot, not a real distribution.

Hover over any dot to see the candy's name.
:::
